Started using FSX back in the 98 days then got into flying real airplanes. Real airplanes got too expensive so I went back to FSX. I have since poured a fairly large chunk of change into the hobby. My flying hardware = Saitek Pro-Flight yoke and pedals - 4 FIP's - switch panel - radio panel - additional throttle quadrant. I am quite happy with the Saitek gear. I still occasionally fly FSX but have pretty much switched to P3D. I have used Megascenery in the past but have switched over to OrbX completely. I have global installed and also own PNW - Northern Rockies - Pacific Fjords and Southern Alaska. Alaska and PNW being my favorite destinations. I mostly fly GA and mostly twins.
